name: ocupilot-ui
description: OcuPilot Angular shell (Story 1.1 workspace/version guard; Story 1.2 tokens/type/strings + client lint; Story 1.9 component suite; Story 1.17 CI gates and the headless-browser harness).

scripts.prebuild: node tools/version-guard.mjs && node tools/client-lint.mjs && node tools/screen-mirror.mjs --check && node tools/classic-links.mjs && node tools/ipm-manifest.mjs --check && node tools/field-lists.mjs --check
scripts.prestart: node tools/version-guard.mjs && node tools/client-lint.mjs && node tools/screen-mirror.mjs --check && node tools/classic-links.mjs && node tools/ipm-manifest.mjs --check && node tools/field-lists.mjs --check
